summary_text: Rockwell Automation shares climbed after stronger-than-expected fiscal Q2 2026 results, sales and earnings beat Wall St. Demand especially strong in warehouse automation, data centers, and semiconductors driving double-digit growth. Management raised FY26 outlook citing momentum in key industrial markets. Plex Smart Manufacturing Platform win at Chocolate Shoppe Ice Cream highlights software/SaaS-led catalyst — customer reported inventory accuracy, waste reduction, and quality control gains. Pricing actions and cost initiatives gaining traction. Long-term narrative projects $9.6B revenue and $1.5B earnings by 2028 (6.2% yearly revenue growth).
